description: Unit tests for unix_domain_client_socket_posix implementation in Chromium, testing socket connection, read/write operations, disconnection, and handling of abstract namespace sockets.

classes.name: UnixDomainClientSocketTest
classes.description: Test fixture for Unix domain client socket unit tests, manages temporary directory and socket path.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Test case for establishing a connection to a Unix domain socket.

methods.name: ConnectWithSocketDescriptor
methods.description: Test case for accepting a socket descriptor and re-wrapping it.

methods.name: ConnectWithAbstractNamespace
methods.description: Test case for connecting using an abstract namespace socket.

methods.name: ConnectToNonExistentSocket
methods.description: Test case for attempting to connect to a non-existent socket file.

methods.name: ConnectToNonExistentSocketWithAbstractNamespace
methods.description: Test case for attempting to connect to a non-existent abstract namespace socket.

methods.name: DisconnectFromClient
methods.description: Test case for disconnecting from the client side and verifying socket states.

methods.name: DisconnectFromServer
methods.description: Test case for disconnecting from the server side and verifying socket states.

methods.name: ReadAfterWrite
methods.description: Test case for reading data after writing, verifying data integrity.

methods.name: ReadBeforeWrite
methods.description: Test case for reading data before writing, testing read/write order.
